name: bodyweight-single-leg-deadlift
instructions:
1. Set up in a standing position with your hands at your side and thumbs facing outward.
2. Keep a slight bend in the plant leg and hinge forward from the hip while keeping the chest tall and thumbs pointing up.
3. Hinge to 90 degrees (if possible) and allow the hamstrings to stretch while keeping the head neutral.
4. Repeat on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions.
